facts.text: I am working with a marketing brief for PTInsights.
PTInsights is a tool that provides insights to optimize shop performance and profitability for independent auto repair shops and collision centers.
PTInsights is for MSOs, shop managers, service advisors, and parts managers.
PTInsights is for current or past users of PartsTrader.
PTInsights has four key dashboards: DRP Scorecard, Margin Breakdown, Preferred Vendors, and Process Overview.
The campaign goal is to raise awareness of PTInsights among current and past users of PartsTrader.
The campaign goal is to drive traffic to the PTInsights page on the PartsTrader website.
The campaign goal is to increase usage and recurring usage of PTInsights.
The campaign will use the hero section of the PartsTrader website to bring awareness and drive traffic to PTInsights after the full rollout in mid-April.
The campaign will promote PTInsights on social media starting in mid-April.
The campaign includes a 4-email drip campaign that highlights each of the four key dashboards.
The 4-email drip campaign highlights the DRP Scorecard dashboard.
The 4-email drip campaign highlights the Margin Breakdown dashboard.
The 4-email drip campaign highlights the Preferred Vendors dashboard.
The 4-email drip campaign highlights the Process Overview dashboard.
Each email in the 4-email drip campaign provides detailed information on features, benefits, and how it can help users optimize shop performance and profitability.
Each email in the 4-email drip campaign drives traffic to the specific dashboard mentioned in the email.
The campaign will run in-app ads to encourage users to view the PTInsights dashboards.
The campaign will send "Metric Emails" that provide shop owners with their actual shop data and drive them to the report dashboards in PTInsights.
The "Metric Emails" will be sent as early as mid-February.
Emails for the 4-email drip campaign and the "metric emails" will begin going out in mid-February.
The hero section of the PartsTrader website and social media promotions will be utilized starting in mid-April after the full rollout of the product.
In-app ads will run for the duration of the campaign.
The end date for the campaign is tentatively mid-May.
The campaign will track awareness by monitoring website traffic to the PTInsights page, social media engagement, and the number of in-app ad views.
The campaign will track engagement by monitoring open and click-through rates for the 4-email drip campaign and the "metric emails".
The campaign will track conversion by monitoring visits to the PTInsights dashboards and return visits.
A hero section on the PartsTrader website promoting PTInsights will be completed by mid-March for launch in mid-April.
Social media posts and ads promoting PTInsights will be completed by mid-March for launch in mid-April.
A 4-email drip campaign will be completed by February 8th for launch in mid-February.
In-app ads will be completed by February 8th for launch in mid-February.
Reports on website traffic, social media engagement, email engagement, in-app ad views, and PTInsights dashboard visits and return visits will be provided on a regular basis throughout the campaign.
I asked why items due later were prioritized over items with an earlier date.
I asked to prioritize items based on due date rather than objective.
I asked what is known about the four email drip campaign.
